chain.text: The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients. The clinic runs 6 consultation rooms. Opening hours are 08:00 to 19:00 on weekdays. Saturday hours are 09:00 to 13:00. Twelve nurses work in three shifts. Four administrative staff work at the clinic. Accreditation has been held since April 2022. Accreditation expires in April 2027. Renewal requires an audit of infection-control records. Attendance averages 180 consultations a day. The January 2025 flu wave peaked at 310 consultations. The no-show rate is 9 percent. The no-show rate was 14 percent before reminder texts. Reminder texts were introduced in September 2024. A vaccine fridge failed overnight in March 2024. Stock worth 2,100 euros was discarded. The fridge now has a networked temperature alarm. The alarm is checked every morning. A paper log is kept as a backup. The alarm failed silently once. The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients.  
The clinic runs 6 consultation rooms.  
Weekday opening hours are 08:00 to 19:00.  
Saturday hours are 09:00 to 13:00.  
Twelve nurses work in three shifts.  
Four administrative staff work at the clinic.  
Accreditation has been held since April 2022.  
Accreditation expires in April 2027.  
Renewal requires an audit of infection-control records.  
Attendance averages 180 consultations a day.  
The January 2025 flu wave peaked at 310 consultations.  
The no-show rate is 9 percent.  
The no-show rate was 14 percent before reminder texts.  
Reminder texts were introduced in September 2024.  
A vaccine fridge failed overnight in March 2024.  
Stock worth 2,100 euros was discarded.  
The fridge now has a networked temperature alarm.  
The alarm is checked every morning.  
A paper log is kept as a backup.  
The alarm failed silently once.  
A patient record was updated by two nurses simultaneously in November 2024.
